title: Contracts result
description: contracts/out/result.json, written by the person's own contracts command (designc.json contracts) after it reads contracts/agents.json (designc.handover.agents/1). designc reads it, shows one row per agent, and a freeze copies the files it names into the handover. result/1 (no agents_hash, no policy) is still displayed but cannot be frozen.

status.description: needs_input: a person must complete something the design cannot know. failed: the compiler refused.

files.description: Every file of the contract, paths under contracts/out/.

policy.description: The agent's policy file (AGT YAML), under contracts/out/. Required when compiled.

agents_hash.description: hash16 of the exact text of contracts/agents.json the command was given (FNV-1a two-pass, as Core._shared.hash16).
